arStrings.szText: {c_important}Purify{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} Faith for each enemy affected by {c_important}Purify{/c}.
{c_important}Purify{/c} also {c_important}{u}Judges{/u}{/c} enemies and its cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[SF_7]{/c} seconds.
Instead of {c_important}{u}Dazing{/u}{/c} enemies, {c_important}Purify{/c} now Stuns for {c_number}{buffduration:BUFF_STUN}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Purify{/c} now can be cast on enemies instead of {c_important}{u}Dazing{/u}{/c} them, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_BURST}{/c} damage and {c_important}{u}Weakning{/u}{/c} them for {c_number}[SF_9]{/c} seconds.
